thread:
sara: quick topic: finalizing rehearsal checklist + registration routing. want a practical, ops-forward webinar for infra and infra-adjacent PMs.

mike: love that. call it 'Serving LLMs: practical runbook for cost & latency'. keep jargon low, but include one slide with config snippets.

elaine: timeline Q 0min content + 30min Q? or keep 40/20?

josh: 40/20 gives room for demos + deeper ops Q. go with that.

priya: from design: two slide flavors: full-ops (deep config) and light (high-level recs). i'll make both and toggle for final.

rafa: registration routing: need two CTAs on the thank-you page: "Request AE demo" and "Start free trial". AE leads -> Salesforce queue 'WEB-AE'. Self-serve -> track utm_campaign=webinar_infer_ops.

tim: infra checklist: verify staging has identical model variant + same quantized weights. i'll snapshot and pin commit id. botops: snapshot scheduled.

botops: snapshot job created: job-20260927-0700, artifact: snap-ef21.

elaine: rehearsal roles: host, demo engineer, slide operator, chat monitor, AE handoff owner. who takes which?

priya: i'll be slide operator + design on deck.

josh: demo engineer for both demos. will write explicit runbooks for each step.

mike: i'll host and handle narrative + live Q.

rafa: i'll own AE handoff and follow-up email; will draft the email sequence (0h, 6h, 48h).

tim: chat monitor volunteering: i can join early and flag any infra issues.

sara: rehearsal schedule:
- 72h dry run: full run (deck, demos, follow-up)
- 24h tech run: slide flow + fallback test
- 30m pre-show backstage sync (roles & signals)

priya: fallback content: 90s recorded clips for each demo, hosted on CDN. will upload and test playback in staging.

josh: demo runbook snippet (will add to doc):
```
# Demo 1: low-latency path
1. Start server: ./start_demo --model=redwood-small --kv-cache=on
2. Warmup: 10 reqs at seq_len=64
3. Run user request: prompt A
4. Validate p99 < 200ms else switch to recording
```

elaine: accessibility & captions: we need live captions enabled and a transcript downloadable after. can ops add CC?

tim: yes, we'll enable live captions via platform setting and capture transcript. add note to follow-up email: "Download transcript".

rafa: tracking: add hidden field lead_tier=enterprise|selfserve depending on CTA clicked. also tag event source=marketing_webinar in SFDC.

sara: poll ideas: 1) role (dev, platform, PM, other) 2) biggest pain (latency, cost, reliability, scaling). keep 2 polls only.

mike: good. also one microbenchmark screenshot showing p99 improvement with batching + cache. keep it minimal.

priya: will design a 1-slide cheatsheet: "Quick settings" (batch_size, kv_cache, quant_mode) + copyable config block.

josh: rehearsals: i'll include a failure-mode run 0s where we simulate model timeout and test fallback trigger. ensure chat monitor knows the exact message to post when swapping to recorded clip.

tim: agreed. chat message: "We're switching to a recorded demo due to an infra hiccup. We'll restore live shortly. Link to recorded clip: <link>".

rafa: follow-up cadence details: immediate thank-you with replay + CTA; 6h technical note with benchmark link; 48h AE outreach for enterprise leads. also segment email by poll response.

priya: need speaker bios (150 words) + headshots by 2026-09-23 EOD. i'll assemble speaker slide.

sara: registration copy callouts: call out "best for platform engineers and product managers", list 2 clear takeaways (config recs + ops checklist). add note: "Bring questions about your deployment config".

mike: final run-of-show draft (times are relative):
00:00 - Host intro & goals (mike)
05:00 - Microbenchmark narrative: how we measure cost & latency (priya + mike)
10:00 - Demo 1: low-latency path (josh)
17:00 - Demo 2: cost-optimized path (josh)
24:00 - Ops cheatsheet & config snippets (priya)
28:00 - Poll results + audience Q (mike + josh)
40:00 - Wrap, CTA, next steps (rafa)

elaine: community boost: add a Slack invite link for attendees to join #community-infra. rafa: can we route some attendee questions to that channel after?

rafa: yes, we'll include the Slack invite in the thank-you email and tag top questions for community follow-up.

sara: final confirmations: can everyone make 72h run on 2026-09-25 09:00 PT and 24h run on 2026-09-26 10:00 PT? reply yes/conflict.

priya: yes
